title: CaseVerification
description: RB-06 Verification panel data for one case (UI spec §6.4, §7.2): one row per document with exactly one of the six labels (or not_applicable), the two independent signature badges (§4.3) and the source checked. Advisory only; a valid uploader signature never makes a document verified (Portal §2.6.3). Demo chains are always shown as TEST TRUST ANCHOR and mock sources as MOCK SOURCE (guard rail 10).

trust_anchor_label.description: Label of the configured trust anchor: 'TEST TRUST ANCHOR' in the demo, the CCA root in production.

format_type.description: T = AICTE template, E = external, P = portal data (design B).

issuer_profile.description: Annexure-14 issuer profile id; null when none is recorded.

adapter_mode.description: Same values as CheckSource.mode; every mock result is shown as MOCK SOURCE.

label.description: Document label = most severe check outcome (Portal §2.6.3); not_applicable only for self-issued documents (UI §6 enum).

response_ref.description: Hash or receipt of the source response; null when no source answered.

actions.description: Suggested next steps for the official (UI §7.2); the workbench has no control that runs them.

checks.description: The document's VerificationResult.checks[] (Portal §2.7), for the panel's detail view.

read.description: How the file was read; the plain sentence for a scan or an unreadable file comes from it.

flags.description: Findings raised on this document (Portal §2.6.4); additive to UI §6.4 so RB-06 can show findings no other P1 screen shows yet (e.g. UDIN).
